name: Seesaw
description: Who gains and who loses from the same thing: a beam on a triangular pivot with a level plate at each end and a title above each side. Items drop onto their plate as stacked weight chips, then the beam tips (about 9 degrees) toward the side that carries more, the plates riding with it, sways gently while it holds, and a verdict pill lands under the pivot; the sinking side's title turns the accent colour and gets an underline. Use it when one event has two sides that weigh differently: who pays and who benefits, what you give up and what you get. Give it a box about 800 x 800 (600-900 wide, 600-1100 tall). Text keeps 40 px and wraps at word boundaries; a box too small is laid out larger and scaled down as a whole.

title.description: who this side is, e.g. Borrowers (48-62 px on one line, two lines when long)

items.description: what lands on this side, bottom chip first

text.description: one gain or loss, 40-52 px, two lines when long

at.description: Time the chip drops: "line:3" or seconds from the clip start. Default: staggered from 0.6 s, left side first

right.description: the right side, same shape as left

title.description: who this side is, e.g. Savers

items.description: what lands on this side, bottom chip first

at.description: Time the chip drops: "line:3" or seconds from the clip start

tilt.description: the side that goes down (carries more); level stays balanced

tilt_at.description: Time the beam tips: "line:5" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 0.6 s after the last chip

verdict.description: one line under the pivot that lands last

text.description: the takeaway, e.g. Savers pay for the rate cut (44-68 px on one line, two lines down to 40 px when long)

at.description: Time it lands: "line:6" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 0.8 s after the tilt

color.description: colour of the sinking side's title and underline: theme token or CSS

ground.description: light: paper panel with ink text; dark: night panel with snow text

verdict.text: Savers pay for the rate cut
